items.question: What are the core working hours at Docwise?
items.ground_truth_answer: Core working hours are 09:00 to 18:00 Europe/Moscow.

items.question: When is the unpaid lunch break?
items.ground_truth_answer: Lunch is 13:00 to 14:00.

items.question: Which weekdays must employees come to the office under the hybrid policy?
items.ground_truth_answer: Office attendance is required on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

items.question: By when must a desk be booked in the Places portal?
items.ground_truth_answer: A desk must be booked before 17:00 on the previous day.

items.question: May employees store client personal data on personal devices?
items.ground_truth_answer: No. Client personal data must not be stored on personal devices.

items.question: Where should a security incident be reported, and how quickly?
items.ground_truth_answer: Email security@docwise.example within one hour.

items.question: What is the rule for gifts from vendors over 50 USD?
items.ground_truth_answer: Gifts from vendors over 50 USD must be declined.

items.question: How long is the standard laptop warranty?
items.ground_truth_answer: The standard laptop warranty is 36 months.

items.question: What is the replacement fee after the first lost badge?
items.ground_truth_answer: 15 USD after the first free replacement.

items.question: How many paid vacation days do employees get per calendar year?
items.ground_truth_answer: 20 days of paid vacation per calendar year.

items.question: How many paid sick days are employees entitled to?
items.ground_truth_answer: 10 paid sick days.

items.question: How far in advance must vacation requests be submitted?
items.ground_truth_answer: At least fourteen days in advance.

items.question: How long is parental leave?
items.ground_truth_answer: Parental leave is 140 calendar days.

items.question: How many unused vacation days may be carried into the next year?
items.ground_truth_answer: A maximum of five days.

items.question: How many paid bereavement leave days are provided?
items.ground_truth_answer: Three paid days.

items.question: Who must approve unpaid leave?
items.ground_truth_answer: Both the manager and HR.

items.question: Do taxi receipts under forty dollars need a manager signature?
items.ground_truth_answer: No. Taxi receipts under 40 USD do not need a manager signature.

items.question: What is the meal cap per person for local client meetings?
items.ground_truth_answer: 25 USD per person.

items.question: When are monthly expense reports due?
items.ground_truth_answer: The fifth business day of the following month.

items.question: How far ahead must international travel be approved by a VP?
items.ground_truth_answer: At least ten calendar days ahead.

items.question: What is the international travel per diem?
items.ground_truth_answer: 75 USD per day.

items.question: When is a business class flight allowed?
items.ground_truth_answer: Only if in-air time exceeds eight hours.

items.question: What is the company card limit for individual contributors?
How long is a new hire assigned a buddy?
items.ground_truth_answer: 30 days.

items.question: Within how many working days must a new engineer open their first pull request?
items.ground_truth_answer: Within five working days.

items.question: What is the default Python version for engineering?
items.ground_truth_answer: Python 3.12.

items.question: How many approvers are required for a production deploy?
items.ground_truth_answer: Two approvers from the on-call rotation.

items.question: After how many days does the on-call starter rotation begin?
items.ground_truth_answer: After 90 days.
